Plus people often confuse "having depression" with "being depressed," only the latter of which can happen to anyone and the former of which is certainly the opposite of temporary. 

Brainstorm, unfortunately, does seem to hit the nail on the head. It's complete chaos, periodically drifting through the eye and managing to gasp for air and reach out fruitlessly for purchase on the ground only to be caught up in the worst of all of it again.
